entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand I bought is not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's broken. It won't sync with my phone or the app. I've tried everything.

Okay, I see. I've pulled up your account and I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 13 days ago. For a claim where the item seems defective like this, our standard procedure is to connect you with our Technical Support team.
I don't want support, I want to return it. It's defective.

I understand your frustration completely. Since you're just past the 10-day window for a direct return on the Pulse, the policy requires our tech team to first verify the fault. They have advanced diagnostic tools and can often solve sync issues right over the phone. If they confirm it's a hardware problem, they are authorized to process a replacement immediately.
So I have to spend more time on another call because you sent me a broken product. Fine.

I apologize for the extra step. I just want to make sure we get this resolved for you as quickly as possible, and they are the best-equipped team to handle a device that won't sync. Would you like me to transfer you to them now?
Whatever. Just get it over with.
Okay. I'm transferring you to a technical specialist now. I've already documented the issue for them, so you won't have to start from scratch. Please hold for one moment.
